Verified · STR 3/3 · 10/10

VCST-6100 — search-bar view_item_list no longer fires on page load

Opening /search?q=<term> used to push the header dropdown's list impression with the dropdown closed. On the PR build the impression is sent only while the dropdown is visible.

Fixed build
vc-theme-b2b-vue 2.59.0-pr-2529-bc4b-bc4b9a08
Pre-fix build
2.59.0-pr-2524-3069-30691594 (vcst-qa)
Platform
3.1076.0
PR
vc-frontend#2529 (open)
Environment
localhost theme, API proxied to vcst-qa · B2B-store · anonymous · 1920 px
Date
2026-10-05

Bug and root cause

search-dropdown.vue runs its search whenever the phrase is set, including when the header fills the phrase from the URL q. searchAndShowDropdownResults() then called analytics("viewItemList", …) without checking visible. The fix guards only the impression; the hidden prefetch stays (7 /graphql calls on load on both builds).
